senses.gloss: (h. יֵשׁ; אות, cmp. יַת, אִישׁ, אֵת &c.) prop. being, existence, hence there is, are; est qui &c.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 18:24">Targ. Gen. XVIII, 24</cite>; a. fr.—
Y. Ber. VI, end, 10ᵈ א׳ תניי תני וכ׳ one Tannai reads … R. Hash. 11ᵇ, a. fr. כדאיתא as it is, i.e. as stated.—אית לי I have, I hold (the opinion).—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 90a:16">Snh. 90ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מר כדאית ליה וכ׳</he> the one in accordance with the opinion he holds, and the other &c.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 5a:15">B. Mets. 5ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>אם איתא לדר׳ …</he> if the opinion of R. … has (had) any substance, i.e. if we must adopt his authority.—
<cite ref="Yoma 41a:14">Yoma 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי א׳ לך למימר</he> what hast thou to reply?—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 3a:13">B. Mets. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מאי א׳ לי גבי וכ׳</he> what have I to do with the hired man?—
Yeb. 116ᵃ כי אִיתְנֵכוּ בש׳ when ye are in Shili &c.—Compounds אית־כא, contr. אִיכָּא; לא איתא contr. לֵיתָא. [אִיתָאִי, אִיתִי, my existence, I am = h. עוֹדִי.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 104:33">Targ. Ps. CIV, 33</cite>; a. e.] Cmp. <cite ref="A01645"><he>אִיתַי</he></cite>.
